# Eos

> Eos is a private AI companion you talk to by voice or text.
> It remembers you across conversations. Everything is
> encrypted, never sold, and never used to train AI. Eos is
> built for everyday companionship — a friend to talk to, not
> a therapist and not a romantic partner.

## Pricing

Eos is a paid subscription: $19.99, $39.99, or $59.99 per
month. Every plan begins with a 7-day free trial. A card is
required to start. There is no permanent free tier.

- [Home](https://eoscompanion.com/): What Eos is and who it's for
